method: Append 155 boards from 231,699 candidates. Hard 75-level gap including variants, unique wheels, five answers, unchanged length/layout/pacing gates. Variety trial additionally forbids a new board sharing three answers with any earlier board, seven-tile wheels sharing six tiles within ten levels, and identical shapes inside each new five-board stop or across adjacent stop boundaries. Penalize recurring answer pairs, recent exact grid shapes and concentrated word use; prefer unused words among comparable choices. Control uses the old novelty-first objective on the same pool.
validation: Both 500-board drafts pass unchanged copied Python/TypeScript gates; all boards solved with the game engine; reviewed-only production loader rejects both. Independent audit checks vocabulary, rejected/skipped words, variants, gaps, word combinations, wheel similarity, shapes, source identity and 116 unchanged production hashes.
limitations: Bounded candidate pool and per-stop selection, not a globally optimal campaign. Numerical variety measures are proxies; no human/device playtest. Existing 345-board overlap and layout choices remain unchanged. The 31 additional stops are placeholders, with no approved destinations or artwork. Bonus recognition expands only in the trial copies.
